entries.wording: Receive item at office of exchange (Otb)
entries.note: Received at the outward office of exchange. Seen in an archived capture of NIPOST's former IPS web tracker at ips.nipost.gov.ng, for an item sent from the Netherlands to Lagos; the events are the sending post's, relayed by UPU messages.

Bagged for dispatch abroad. Seen in an archived capture of NIPOST's former IPS web tracker at ips.nipost.gov.ng, for an item sent from the Netherlands to Lagos; the events are the sending post's, relayed by UPU messages.

Dispatched to the destination country. Seen in an archived capture of NIPOST's former IPS web tracker at ips.nipost.gov.ng, for an item sent from the Netherlands to Lagos; the events are the sending post's, relayed by UPU messages.
At a NIPOST hub or sorting centre. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
On its way between offices. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
Held for customs clearance. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
Sorted for delivery, before the delivery round; the page puts it level with out for delivery. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
On the delivery round. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
A delivery attempt failed; the page also gives this key to scans saying the recipient was not available. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
Delivered. The tracking page's code labels a scan with this key and sets its progress bar by it.
